name: Private app requires sign-in
description: Signed-out users see only a bilingual login entry, never sample clients or private records.
steps: Open the app while signed out
Confirm the welcome screen has an account sign-in action and no clients, payments or sample records
Tap Sign in and complete account authentication
expected: A signed-out user sees only the login screen; authenticated user enters their own workspace.

name: Private client data persists
description: A signed-in coach retains their client data across reload and it is hidden on sign-out.
steps: Create a client named Private Coach Client
Refresh and confirm the client remains
expected: Client is saved for the signed-in account; after sign-out only the sign-in screen is visible.

name: Membership and manual records
description: The app supports genuine signed-in records without claiming automated charges or messages.
steps: Sign in and add a client with contact details
Create a membership with a Stripe Payment Link
Record a paid Cash or Check entry
Create a reminder and open its email draft
expected: Records save to the private account and email opens a draft; no automatic send or charge is claimed.

name: Bilingual settings and legal pages
covers: Powered by The Launch Era footer
description: Verifies Spanish and English private-app UI and installation/legal help.
steps: Open Settings and select Español latino
Inspect the navigation and installation instructions
Open Terms and Privacy and switch to English
expected: Language selection works and legal pages contain no fictional preview descriptions.
